answer: Bridge planks are earned, not given. Each identity rigs one plank into the bridge — one vote seat per key; every vote mints 16 POA of share, vesting only as audits weld struts onto its ridge. Each epoch the roll looses a gale — a fresh nonce its key must lash on within 60 seconds. Lottery riggers replay one plank in five per epoch. A missed, stale, or shared lash tips the unvested share to the audit fund, benching the key two epochs. N fakes × 16 POA = 16N POA forfeited per epoch. Limit: honest keys vest alike.
